scope: Phase-1 production changes only: kept-axis reduction, neutral-domain trimming, MR2, chunk geometry and backend state/cache fixes. No final full-input acceptance; narrow/width follow-ups require additional review.
review_method: Read real consumer integration, legality guards, source control-flow and independent oracle construction. Owner native evidence is identified separately from this reviewer’s own executions.

checks.finding: All three LowerOptions flags are carried by CompileOptions through both Compiler and FactoryCompiler; disabled values enter identity_part. Environment off values map conservatively to False.

Matches a single unshifted signed32/64 arange prefix mask, all external memory shares that identical SSA predicate; volatile/control/effect/unknown ops decline. Every sum/min/max explicitly selects its identity, index reductions decline. Whole invalid chunks are omitted; original partial-tail masks and combine order remain.

Only FP32 sum on contiguous reduced axes followed by contiguous kept suffix, dense 4-byte staging, no index result; width divides suffix so chunks never cross prefix rows. Each lane reads reduced coordinates 0..T-1 in the existing order and uses separate FP32 add. Operand conversions/product/FMA boundaries are not moved.

Even M, complete N chunks, LMUL1 guard; chain loads original nonzero accumulator rows, non-chain begins at zero; per-output K-order and FMA operand order match old path. Reads are private staged FP32/BF16-widened data. Odd M/tails retain old path.
Compares old chunk extent/VL/SEW before updating next pass geometry and closes the old loop using old values. Recorded old stride cannot silently inherit wider next-pass VL.

Allocator slot capacity VLENB*LMUL, emitter validates aligned non-overlapping legal groups and stack slot size; whole-register memory neither reads nor changes VL/VTYPE. Mask spills remain refused. Byte/state/scratch oracle covers zero and partial AVL.

The removed full-VL ambient assertion described the old implementation restriction. Replacement requires whole-register forms; original real operator execution checks remain. New independent backend-state native byte/state witnesses support relaxing the runtime-AVL allocation refusal.

nonblocking_findings.finding: The phase-1 snapshot binds SDK lock in complete-program identity but not runtime-object stamp. Fixed-SDK assumption prevents this from affecting the current measurements. Backend owner has subsequently added the lock digest to runtime-object stamp and a real recompile witness; final source review must bind that correction.
